answer_1.quote: We focus on a medical domain summarization task in automatic clinical note generation from doctor-patient conversations ...

answer_2.quote: We use QuickUMLS to extract medical concepts ... and then calculate F1-scores ... We also use GPT4 preference as measurements to evaluate summary quality ...

answer_3.quote: We use GPT4 to give preference ranking on different AI-generated summaries based on the conversation snippet and reference summary.

answer_4.quote: We asked 2 medical students to rate summaries from CC based on the same information ... Human ranking agrees with the GPT4 ranking.
answer_4.guideline: Medical students rated the generated summaries based on the conversation snippet and reference summary.
